types.title: Boolean
types.description: A true or false literal.

types.title: JSON value
types.description: Any strict JSON literal.

types.title: Math
types.description: Finite arithmetic; division by zero is an explicit failure.

types.title: Array
types.description: An array literal or an incoming array.

types.title: Object
types.description: An object literal or an incoming object.

types.title: Get property
types.description: Read an object key or array index; use default when absent.

types.title: JavaScript sandbox
types.description: Run bounded JavaScript in an isolated V8 child process. Return an outputs object.

types.title: Preview
types.description: Expose the exact incoming JSON value in execution results.

types.title: Experiment configuration
types.description: Validate a partial config and produce a complete PyTorch experiment config.

types.title: Custom dataset
types.description: Build finite float32 input/target samples without executing training.

types.title: Create experiment
types.description: Create an independent real PyTorch experiment; optionally import custom data.

types.title: Train
types.description: Execute real training steps. Cancellation is checked between completed steps.

types.title: Branch experiment
types.description: Branch exact live parameter, optimizer, scheduler, data and observation state.

types.title: Capture checkpoint
types.description: Capture a complete real training checkpoint on the selected run.

types.title: Inspect experiment
types.description: Read an actual recorded step or the live run snapshot; optionally include data.

types.title: Manual intervention
types.description: Explicitly edit finite parameter/LR or supported optimizer memory on a real paused run.

types.title: Verify record chain
types.description: Verify the actual immutable numerical record hash chain.

types.title: Experiment control
types.description: Explicitly play, pause, reset live state, or restart an existing experiment.

types.title: Export evidence
types.description: Generate and retain an immutable ZIP of actual numerical evidence, bound to this execution.

types.title: HF model configuration
types.description: Create an offline AutoConfig recipe. No model download or remote code.

types.title: HF AutoModel
types.description: Instantiate an actual supported HF model from config after a meta-device parameter budget check.

types.title: Cached HF pretrained model
types.description: Load actual cached safetensors weights by public Hub repository and pinned commit. No downloads, arbitrary paths, remote code or pickle.

types.title: Cached HF AutoTokenizer
types.description: Load a matching cached fast tokenizer by repository and pinned Hub commit. Never imports remote tokenizer code.

types.title: Local HF fast tokenizer
types.description: Build a real offline WordLevel PreTrainedTokenizerFast from an editable vocabulary.

types.title: Tokenize text
types.description: Tokenize and pad text; causal labels mask padding with -100.

types.title: Tensor dataset
types.description: Finite named tensor batches: x/labels for custom models or input_ids/attention_mask/labels for HF.

types.title: Layer recipe
types.description: A declarative PyTorch layer. Connect recipes into Compose layers / Sequential / custom forward.

types.title: Linear
types.description: Trainable dense projection with arbitrary bounded input/output width.

types.title: Embedding
types.description: A trainable token embedding table.

types.title: RMSNorm
types.description: Actual torch.nn.RMSNorm. Normalization connects to layer outputs; optimizers bind the complete model.

types.title: LayerNorm
types.description: Actual torch.nn.LayerNorm.

types.title: Activation
types.description: A stateless tensor activation.

types.title: Self attention
types.description: Trainable batch-first multi-head self attention with optional causal masking.

types.title: Compose layers
types.description: Join two layer recipes or composed layer lists. Connect the layers output to Sequential.

types.title: Append layer
types.description: Append an individual layer to a layer list.

types.title: Sequential model
types.description: Instantiate a real multi-parameter PyTorch architecture from ordered layer recipes.

types.title: Custom tensor forward
types.description: Editable restricted Python tensor expressions and named trainable layers. No imports, attributes, loops, eval or exec.

parameters.name: code

types.title: Optimizer
types.description: Optimizer recipe. Connect to Train alongside a model; AdamW updates the model's complete parameter set.

types.title: Train multi-parameter model
types.description: Actual autograd/optimizer updates, finite loss checks, gradient clipping, measured parameter hashes and loss history.

types.title: Forward pass
types.description: Run a real model forward; tensors remain in the job worker and expose shape/dtype/value previews.

types.title: Evaluate model
types.description: Evaluate a finite loss and optional classification accuracy without changing weights.

types.title: HF generate
types.description: Real bounded HF autoregressive generation with attention masks and deterministic default sampling.

types.title: HF pipeline
types.description: Actual Transformers pipeline with a job-local model/tokenizer, offline inference and bounded inputs.

types.title: Inspect model
types.description: Real parameter names, shapes, trainable counts, architecture, finite checks and weight hash.

types.title: Export safe model
types.description: Immutable ZIP with safetensors weights and a declarative architecture recipe. No pickle or executable model code.

types.title: Load safe model
types.description: Load only a registered graph artifact, verify safe ZIP/recipe/safetensors and rebuild within model budgets.

types.title: Token / mask input
types.description: A symbolic model input. Its connected operations replay on every forward pass, training update and generated token.

types.title: Token embedding
types.description: Editable trainable vocabulary table; converts token IDs into hidden vectors.

types.title: Projection / LM head
types.description: A separately registered trainable Linear projection. Use for Q, K, V, attention output, gate, up, down or vocabulary head.

types.title: RMSNorm operation
types.description: Trainable RMS normalization in the forward graph, with float32 variance accumulation and editable epsilon.

types.title: Position IDs from mask
types.description: Convert a binary padding mask to zero-based, padding-aware position IDs for rotary embeddings.

types.title: Rotary position / RoPE
types.description: Apply real split-half rotary position embeddings to a Q or K projection. Connect editable position IDs or use the batch mask's positions.

types.title: Grouped-query causal attention
types.description: Q/K/V tensor inputs, grouped KV heads, scaled scores, padding/causal mask, softmax and weighted values. Every connection participates in autograd.

types.title: SiLU activation
types.description: The parameter-free activation in the expanded SwiGLU gate branch.

types.title: Gated product
types.description: Elementwise multiply two equally shaped tensors, for the SiLU gate × up branch.

types.title: Residual addition
types.description: Add two equally shaped tensor branches without hiding the skip connection.

types.title: SwiGLU block
types.description: Editable fused trainable gate/up/down projections. Use the expanded template to wire each projection, SiLU and product separately.

types.title: Custom tensor operation
types.description: A reusable forward block with up to three wired tensors and optional named trainable layers. Restricted tensor expressions preserve autograd; no imports or arbitrary Python.

types.title: Compile visual causal model
types.description: Compile the connected tensor DAG into a trainable causal language model. Shared visual nodes register weights once; the saved recipe replays for training, generation and checkpoint reload.
